title: Rice Shower: Creeper Indicator
description: Rice Shower from Umamusume: Pretty Derby is here to accompany you on your Minecraft adventures! If a Creeper is lurking nearby, she’ll be the first to let you know.
body:
Rice Shower from Umamusume: Pretty Derby is here to accompany you on your Minecraft adventures! But stay alert — she is extremely sensitive to danger. If a Creeper is lurking nearby, she’ll be the first to let you know.

💨 How it works
A Rice Shower icon appears in the top-left corner of your screen. As soon as a Creeper enters your vicinity:

The Warning: Rice starts to tremble visibly.

Proximity Scaling: The closer the green menace gets, the more she panics! The shaking animation intensifies as the danger nears.

Intuitive Safety: No need to constantly strain your ears for that faint hissing sound—just keep an eye on your companion’s reaction.

✨ Features
Animated HUD: Real-time character reactions based on mob proximity.

No More Surprises: Perfect for players who mine while listening to music or just want to avoid an unexpected "Bada-boom" from behind.

Anime Aesthetic: A compact, cute UI element that provides utility without cluttering your view.
